title: Northgate Tire Center Service Terms: Rotation, Rebalancing and Flat Repair
content:
# Service terms for rotation, rebalancing and flat repair

These are the service terms of every Northgate Tire Center package. Clauses marked as no longer in force remain listed so the record of the terms is complete, but they no longer govern any charge.

## Clauses

1. **Rotation fee — no longer in force.** The clause "rotations are free where the package includes lifetime rotation and otherwise cost the package's rotation fee per visit" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for charging a rotation visit.
2. **Recommended interval.** The Tire Center recommends a rotation once every recommended rotation interval set by the package, in miles.
3. **Rebalancing fee — no longer in force.** The clause "rebalancing is free where the package includes lifetime rebalancing and otherwise costs the package's rebalancing fee per tire" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
4. **Repairable puncture.** A puncture is repairable only when it is no wider than the package's largest repairable puncture and, where the package repairs in the tread area only, lies in the tread area.
5. **Flat repair fee — no longer in force.** The clause "repairable flats are free where the package includes flat repair and otherwise cost the package's flat repair fee" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for charging a flat repair.
6. **Non-repairable puncture.** A puncture that is wider, in the shoulder or sidewall, or overlaps an earlier repair is non-repairable and can only be replaced — under road hazard protection where the package has it, at the member's expense otherwise.
7. **Roadside assistance.** Flat-tire roadside assistance is available for the package's roadside assistance months from installation.
8. **Separate entries — no longer in force.** The clause "each fee is its own entry on the visit's service date" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Repairability, condition by condition

| Puncture width | Location | Overlaps an earlier repair | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| at or below the largest repairable width | tread area | no | repairable |
| above the largest repairable width | any | any | non-repairable; replaced only |
| any | shoulder or sidewall | any | non-repairable; replaced only |
| any | any | yes | non-repairable; replaced only |

**Hypothetical boundary cases** on a package whose largest repairable puncture is 0.25 inches and which repairs in the tread area only: a 0.25-inch puncture in the tread area, not overlapping any repair, is repairable; a 0.26-inch puncture in the tread area is non-repairable.

## Replacement of a non-repairable tire

A non-repairable tire is replaced under road hazard protection where the package has that protection; on a package without it, the replacement is at the member's expense.
